title: Agriculture & Smart Farming
painPoint: Modern agriculture demands high-precision GPS-guided autonomous tractors and harvesters with compact yet powerful servo motors. Farm equipment operates in extreme temperature swings, high humidity, dust, and vibration. Standard magnets suffer flux loss in these conditions—N42 grades demagnetize when motors overheat during long harvest seasons, while weaker magnets force oversized motor designs that waste battery capacity in electric farm vehicles. Magnetic grain separators need high coercivity to remove ferrous contaminants reliably at high throughput, and irrigation pump motors require consistent torque under variable load.
youjiuSolution: YOUJIU supplies agriculture-grade NdFeB magnets engineered for field durability. Our N42SH and N38SH grades maintain flux stability at 150°C for GPS-guided autonomous steering motors, while N52 blocks maximize torque density in compact precision seeding actuators. For grain cleaning systems, our 35UH high-coercivity magnets deliver superior separation of ferrous contaminants at high throughput. Every batch undergoes salt-spray corrosion testing and PCT pressure-cooker validation to ensure performance in humid, dusty field environments.
